# ShiftHub — Dashboard Data API

GET /webhook/shifthub-dashboard

Returns the next-14-days coverage picture as JSON for the ShiftHub web app (served through the Vercel proxy at /api/dashboard). Also works with curl or any HTTP client.

CORS-friendly JSON; no authentication (read-only, no personal data beyond names/roles/wards).

nodes.name: Dashboard Webhook
nodes.notes: HTTP entry point. Point the Vercel app (or curl) at this URL.

nodes.notes: Aggregates the next 14 days of rota into coverage stats + per-shift detail.
